entry.title: Harry Potter 2 PC v2.12.0
entry.content:
# HP2PC_AP v2.12.0 The other Harry Potter 2 players in your room show up as ghosts, the client says exactly what is blocking a launch or a mod update, and a Gold Card Room logic fix.
### New - **Ghost players** (`ghost_players`, on by default). Other Harry Potter 2 players in the room who are on the same map appear in your game as translucent Harrys, moving and animating as they play, and your Harry appears in theirs. Each ghost carries its slot name over its head in a colour of its own, and mirrors the peer's disguise, size, wand and upside-down state. Cosmetic only: a ghost has no collision and cannot be targeted. `/ghosts` takes `on`, `off` or `seed` like the other link commands, and a bare `/ghosts` flips it. Off also stops sharing your own position.
### Changed - **The client tells the launcher window from a running game.** When a connect skips the auto-launch or a mod update because something is up, the message now says whether that is Harry Potter itself or the New Game / Load Game launcher window, and which one to close. - **A mod update that could not land holds the auto-launch.** When the apworld carries a newer mod build than your install and the update is refused (a game or the launcher window is up) or fails, the client no longer starts a game on the old build. Fix it and reconnect, or type `/play` to start the game as it is. While an older build is still bridged, the game shows an `AP: mod update ...` reminder every ten seconds. - **A refused write raises a popup.** When Windows will not let the client write into the install (almost always a `Program Files` install with the launcher not run as administrator), the client raises an error popup naming the folder and the fix, instead of a line in the log. The sound and music randomizers get the same popup. - **The WRONG INSTALL warning repeats.** A seed on the wrong install (an open castle seed on vanilla maps, or the reverse) now shows its warning every ten seconds, not once per level.
### Logic and content changes - **Every Gold Card Room card needs Spongify, or Rictusempra with Flipendo.** That is the gate on the room's first room. In open castle, Rictusempra alone used to pass. Vanilla is unaffected in practice, since entering the room there already needs Flipendo.
## Poptracker 1.0.9
### Changed - Access rules regenerated for the Gold Card Room gate: Spongify, or Rictusempra with Flipendo.

entry.title: Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.6
entry.content: # Laika: Aged Through Blood v0.1.6 Release! 🎊 More ways to finish your run, more control over how you start, and a fresh look for Archipelago items! This update brings configurable victory goals, starting inventory, shop previews, new QoL options, and fixes for item delivery, Viscera recovery, and weapon swapping. ## New Victory Goals - **Choose your finish line:** Victory can now come from defeating selected bosses, collecting Puppy Gifts, or completing Wastelander band quests. - **Boss goals:** Choose which of the six supported bosses count and how many you must defeat. You can keep Two-Beak God as your goal or build a different boss route. - **Puppy Gifts:** Require anywhere from **1–7 distinct gifts** received through Archipelago. Duplicate gifts do not count toward the total, and you do not need to deliver them to Puppy for this goal. - **Wastelanders:** Require anywhere from **1–6 Wastelander band quest completions**. - **Combine categories:** Require one, two, or all three enabled goal categories to finish your seed. - **Live goal checklist:** Added an optional on-screen checklist showing your remaining goals and progress. - **Generation checks:** Invalid combinations, such as requiring more bosses than you selected, produce a clear generation error. ## Starting Inventory - **Choose your starting items:** Added `start_inventory_from_pool`, allowing you to begin with selected items taken from your randomized pool and replaced with filler. - **Start with supplies:** Viscera and ingredients are supported alongside equipment and other eligible items. - **Both weapon modes supported:** Names such as `Blueprint: Shotgun` work in both Direct and Crafting mode, following that mode’s existing grant behavior. - Items that require a safe quest state still wait until they can be delivered properly, and weapon upgrades can remain pending until their weapon is available. ## Shops, Previews, and Presentation - **See what you are buying:** Randomized offers in shops, travelling merchants, and Renato’s map purchases now show the Archipelago item and its recipient. - **Optional automatic hints:** You can now enable or disable `automatic_purchase_hints` to create AP hints when opening eligible purchase previews. Previewing or cancelling an offer does not buy it or send its location check. - **Custom Laika AP artwork:** Added new Laika-themed Archipelago artwork to randomized purchase previews and AP item/location presentations. - **Clearer item popups:** Improved received-item and location-check presentation, including sender information where available. - **Less popup flooding:** Bursts of significant received items can be grouped into a summary. ## New YAML and QoL Options - **Configurable transition skips:** Choose whether to skip Jakob’s transition, Orella’s transition, and Roy’s boat sequences. - **One Roy setting:** `skip_roy_boat` controls both the outbound presentation and the later return dialogue. Quest softlock protections remain active regardless of the skip setting. - **Viscera Protection:** Choose normal death behavior, protection from incoming DeathLink deaths only, or protection from all deaths. Previously dropped bags are unaffected. - **Optional goal display:** Use `show_goal_checklist` to show or hide the new victory checklist. Enabled by default. - Victory categories, required totals, selected bosses, starting inventory, and automatic purchase hints can all be configured for your seed. ## Fixes and Reliability - **Unsaved Viscera recovery:** AP Viscera received after your last save can now be restored when continuing that save, including while disconnected from the server. - **Materials and ingredients:** Added equivalent recovery for unsaved AP crafting materials and ingredients. - **No repeated refunds:** Saved receipts stay complete after their currency or materials have been spent. - **Shop purchases:** Completed AP shop purchases now save, preserving the purchased reward, shop stock, and Viscera cost when returning to the title screen. - **Menu and save handling:** Improved item delivery across reconnects, save reloads, and deleting/recreating saves. Items wait for the gameplay save to be ready. - **Black-screen item prompts:** Fixed early item popups blocking the opening scene until their prompts were dismissed. - **Early weapon grants:** Refreshing weapons when boarding the bike helps newly received weapons become usable without needing to die or change scenes. - **Weapon wheel:** Fixed selection problems involving empty slots and mismatches between the selected wheel entry and equipped weapon. - **Hectist safeguards:** Expanded protection against reaching her final conversation before the required earlier quest steps. - **Connection controls:** Fixed a case where connecting from the title screen could leave the AP settings panel unresponsive. - **Overlay interaction:** The informational AP overlay no longer intercepts clicks intended for other controls. - **Saved options:** Improved preservation of seed settings across reconnects and save loading, and fixed cached goal lists accumulating duplicate entries. ## Messages and Cleanup - Added a **[Chat]** label to chat messages. - Corrected messages that described another player finding their own item as though you had found it. - Fixed missing spacing in hint messages. - Standardized player-facing DeathLink messages. - Corrected the currency item name to **Viscera x300**, matching the amount already granted. - Removed temporary boat/hook diagnostic tracing. ## Updating Update both the Laika mod, APWorld, as well as the `.yaml` file. Generate a new seed with the updated options to use the new run settings! Please try them out! The new consumable recovery protects receipts recorded after installing this update. It cannot safely reconstruct Viscera or materials already lost before the update. Which is why, as always, I recommend you use this new version on fresh runs/generated seeds. That's all for now! Please report any bugs here, and hope you enjoy all the new changes!

entry.title: Kirby & The Amazing Mirror v0.4.0rc2
entry.content:
## v0.4.0
### New Features - Added `minimum_health` and `maximum_health` YAML options for a custom starting/final HP capacity (Issues #778, #947). Defaults remain 6/10; all starting/final ranges within 1..10 HP are supported with up to nine unique Vitality Counter upgrades. Existing One-Hit Mode presets override these options. - mGBA now supported as an optional emulator. - All minor chests are added as locations and no longer provide their native item. - Spray Paints and Music Sheets added as AP items. - Added an `/abilities` client command that lists the abilities currently unlocked for the slot (Issue #891, PR #951). - Added a new option: `enemy_health_multiplier`. Scale all enemies' health values between 50% to 500% of the original game. It defaults to 100% which matches the original game (Issue #880). - Added `random_color_per_room` to Starting Kirby Color. It chooses an initial supported palette at generation, then changes to a different supported palette whenever the connected BizHawk client observes Kirby enter a different room (Issue #857). - Added four progression items that independently open the walls controlled by those levers. Pulling a lever now sends its AP location check without opening the wall; receiving the matching Lever Wall item sets the native wall-unlock state instead (Issue #859).
### Improvements - Ability unlock gating also applies at the final native ability commit, after roulette and other pending-ability writes (Issue #892). - Unused Vitality Counters are replaced through the existing filler/trap policy while all vitality-chest checks remain available. - The Tutorial World Map - Big Chest location check is now sent during the tutorial; item delivery remains paused until normal gameplay begins (Issue #868). - Consolidated `defeat_random_hidden_area_boss` and `defeat_configured_area_boss` into the canonical `defeat_area_boss` goal. `configured_area_boss: random` now uses Archipelago's standard `Choice` randomization, the old `defeat_configured_area_boss` name remains a safe YAML alias, and all eight boss-to-area mappings are corrected (Issue #872). - Generated YAML documentation now shows the scalar `configured_area_boss: random` and `starting_kirby_color: random` shorthands and explains how they replace the generated concrete weight mappings (Issue #872).
### Known Limitations - Progression: The entire game is still only two spheres. This means you can complete almost the entirety of Kirby and the Amazing Mirror without ever having to receive an item, except open the Dimension Mirror. In other words, you can do everything in the game except defeat Dark Mind without ever receiving an item from another player. This is a consequence of the original game design. We have plans to gate your progression in other ways, but they all require coding/hacking in intentional blockers. - Use newly generated ROM patches for offline custom health initialization; older patches need a same-seed rebuild to embed health bounds. Client reconciliation remains required for authoritative AP ownership. Full gameplay coverage of every custom-health interaction remains pending. - Kirby Color: random_color_per_room changes Kirby's color but does not update the corresponding UI element colors. - Localization: Only the North American ROM is supported. All AP notifications are in English. - Native sprites and animations: Chests still show their original item sprite and collection animation. Statues still show their original ability. - mGBA notifications appear as plain text in the **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel, which must be visible. They do not appear over the game image.
### Bug Fixes
- Boss checks were mapped incorrectly for the `defeat_configured_area_boss` goal. That's been fixed (Issue #893). - Adds cutter to the base ability pool to make sure players can cut the drop down platforms. (Issue #894) - Preserve locally found ability unlocks after reconnecting by requesting the full received-item history from the server (Issue #910).
### Internal Changes - Added shared health-range validation, full supported-range item-pool coverage, client reconciliation regression tests, and YAML/slot-data contracts without changing payload offsets or item IDs. - Added pinned, checksum-verified Archipelago generation fuzzing with a strict local launcher, a pull-request/manual CI workflow, and retained failure artifacts (Issue #898). - `starting_kirby_color` now uses the same standard Archipelago `Choice` literal `random`; the former world-specific `random_color` sentinel has been removed (Issue #872). - Split Kirby color catalog validation into focused helpers so Flake8 complexity checks remain meaningful without suppressing C901 (Issue #872).

entry.title: AEMinecraft v0.7.0rc2
entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.2
**Pre-release.** Second test build of v0.7.0. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game.
For everything new in v0.7.0, see the **[v0.7.0-rc.1 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.1)**. This RC only changes the apworld; the mod is the same code as rc.1, rebuilt with the new version number.
### Fixed
- **Generation hung on some BACAP slots.** With structures and mobs locked, glitch logic could take minutes or never finish building. That step now takes a couple of seconds. - **Same seed, different logic.** The exported logic depended on Python's hash seed, so two runs of the same seed could ship slightly different rules. It is now identical every time. Item placement was never affected.
### Faster
- **BACAP multiworlds generate several times faster.** The `advancements_required` goal check stops as soon as enough advancements are reachable, and rule evaluation and logic minimisation do less work. Same seeds give the same placement and slot data as before.
### Upgrading from rc.1
- **Replace the apworld.** The rc.1 mod jars and YAMLs keep working with it, but you may as well grab the rc.2 jar.

1.0.0 is here! This release includes many, many new features and improvements, and there's a good chance it includes one or two new bugs as well. If you run into any issues or weird behavior, or would like to give some general feedback, please write in the [Discord thread](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1037751568700805141)! If you'd like to stay on the previous version, e.g. to continue playing in an ongoing async, make sure to [manually install](https://github.com/Snyax/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/x2wotc/docs/mod_manual_installation.md) the mod to prevent Steam from auto-updating. ## Changes ### New Features - Added Ranksanity - Enable `Ranksanity` option to add new items and locations for soldier class promotions and rank-up events - Toggle `Global Promotions` option to determine behavior of excluded classes - Fully LWOTC-compatible! - Added DeathLink - Enable `DeathLink` option in your YAML or change your mind via in-game Mod Config Menu at any time - Set `DeathLink Chance` option to play dice with your soldiers' lives (can also be changed in MCM) - Added more options for better access to exclusive soldier classes to enable less punishing DeathLinks - Overhauled trap items - Removed `[Trap] Force Level +1` and added many more traps, both for the Strategy and Tactical layers - Enable `Disable Turn One Traps` option to ignore tactical traps from before a mission started - Enable `Disable All Traps` in MCM if you bit off more than you can chew (it happens) - Traps may range anywhere from 'mild inconvenience' to 'potentially run-threatening', enable whichever ones you like with the `Active Traps` option and please give feedback if they feel too strong or boring! - Overhauled progressive weapon items - New `[Tech] Progressive Gun` track includes rifle, shotgun, cannon, and sniper techs, the order of later items is shuffled and different each seed - `Split Progressive Items` option allows splitting these techs into separate rifle/shotgun and cannon/sniper tracks - Added `progressive` option to `Chosen Huntsanity`, grouping Chosen Hunt items into three progressive items - Added `Exclude Post-Goal Locations` option to accomodate early-goal sync settings - Added `Enemy Plando Preset` option, feel free to suggest new presets if there are fun settings you like using :) ### Client - Overhauled connection, version checking, and writing to game config - Client no longer prompts user for game path on launch but on connection - All version checking now happens directly in the client, connection will be closed if versions are incompatible - Added `/game_path`, `/workshop_path`, and `/reset_paths` client commands to remove need to open `host.yaml` - `/version` client command now displays world and mod version info when connected - Client now prints an error on connection when config file is missing version info - Added `/progressive` client command to print info about active progressive items - Client now prints names of valid progressive items if user attempts to hint one of their stages - Client now supports launching from WebHost by clicking the slot name on the room page - Proxy is now properly assigned a free port by the OS instead of using a generic default ### Generation - Logic now tightly follows `Remove Corpse Costs` option - `get_filler_item_name()` now respects filler share options - Various logic difficulty tweaks, especially for early locations - Various optimizations, massively lowering generation times - Improvements to item and location name groups ### Mod - Mod no longer allows launching while disconnected or while connected with incompatible version info - Minimized GameStates added to history in Strategy layer to significantly reduce risk of save file bloat - Improved guardrails around offline location checking - Replaced UI strings for objectives waiting on multiworld items - Streamlined Chosen Hunt locations for more intuitive behavior - Partial research project hints now reveal item classification in addition to flavor text - LWOTC rebels and VIPs now scale with items received from the multiworld - Removed science and engineering requirements from proving ground projects - Corpse costs are now also removed from proving ground projects if the option is enabled ### Bug Fixes - Fixed a bug where Avatars could spawn damaged in the final mission - entry.title: Wikipelago v1.1.0
entry.content:
## Main changes
- **Topic Realms** (on by default). Every side road becomes a Realm with its own topic (History, Music, Sports…). Each Realm opens with its own Portal item instead of Branch Keys, so Realms can open in any order. Realm targets and rerolls stay on topic. - **Realm Master goal** (`goal: realm_master`). Win by clearing every Realm. No fragments, no Grand Goal question. - **Practice mode updated**: a 5×5 bingo board and one open Realm, each replaceable once finished. - **Phone layout and display options**
## Improvements
- New dark and light themes, card icons, self-hosted fonts, text size selection, contrast mode, and colorblind-friendly colors. - Notifications are now a dismissible stack at the top of the screen. - In the Journey panel, hover a point to see the page summary, click it to open the page on Wikipedia. - The Compass reads toward your nearest live target and updates in the background. - Added a welcome screen before you connect, and removed made-up progress shown before connection. - UI responds better to different horizontal and vertical resolutions. - Bingo: Œ and Æ count as two letters (OE, AE), as in Scrabble. - Rephrasing of certain page categories, more pages are flagged as sensitive, Grand Goal questions reworded to avoid giving the answer away. - Large rooms: websocket messages up to 16 MB (from **mooinglemur**'s fork).
## Fixes
- DeathLink deaths and traps could apply twice in a row. - Double-clicking a link to the target could skip a round. - Pages that differ only by accents ("Año" / "Ano", "Bürger" / "Burger") were treated as the same page. - A short connection drop reloaded the page, jumped to the top and used up a queued trap. Now the page stays, and a target reached while disconnected counts once the connection is back. - The Journey pop-out window could take deaths and traps meant for the main window. - After Practice, joining a room started on the last practice page instead of your round. - Light theme contrast, header alignment, and missing pinyin, Vietnamese and pronunciation characters.
## For hosts and players
- Recommended Archipelago version: 0.6.7. - Games generated with 1.0.x keep working on the updated web client. - `topic_portals` now defaults to true, so a YAML without that line gets Realms. Set `topic_portals: false` for classic Branch Keys. - The hosted client no longer connects to private-network addresses (localhost, LAN, Tailscale…). For those rooms, run the local client: see [Setup, Option 2](docs/setup.md#option-2--local-client-private--vpn-rooms). - Bugs: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Dreskn/Wikipelago-Continued/issues) or the Wikipelago thread on the Archipelago Discord.

entry.title: Ys Origin v2.1.0
entry.content:
A logic release. A full multiworld run as Toal, played out of order from a 1F start, turned up a string of places where the tower can only be walked one way or needs the double jump, and the logic did not know. Requires **Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer**.
> **Take all three files, and take them together.** This apworld refuses a `dinput8.dll` older than 2.1: an old dll on a new seed used to fail silently (items arriving and doing nothing), and is now turned away at connect with a message. Seeds generated with 2.0.x stay playable with the new dll.
**New: a [setup guide and settings builder](https://4rtefakt.github.io/ys-origin-archipelago/)** on the web. It walks through the install and builds your yaml in the browser.
## 🗺️ Logic
Every one of these was a check or a passage the generator could count on while it was out of reach.
**Rooms that only work one way** - **21F boss (Pictimos).** Coming down from 22F you arrive behind him: he blocks the way and the fight never starts. His arena is entered from the 21F save only. - **9F boss door.** The Pre-Boss Room's ward barrier stands across it with the wards on the room side, so the boss room does not lead back down. - **8F Waterway Entrance.** Its grate opens when four ward monsters die, and they all stand on the Outer Corridor side. Coming up from the waterway is a dead end. - **18F Path 1.** Its four spear gates are lowered by switches on the way up. From the top (18F Path 2) the first gate is shut, so the 18F save and Toal's Room are reached from below only.
**Places that need the double jump (Gold Bracelet)** - **Slippery Fork Path (16F).** The room is a pit: all three chests and 16F Path 2 are on the walkway and ledges above the floor. The way up is the climb in 16F Path 1 (double jump) or the slippery ramp from 16F Path 3 (Earth Dragon's Claws). - **20F save to 20F Drop-Off**, in both directions. - The chests of **20F Path 3**, **20F Small Room** and both of **22F Path 3**. - **22F Path 2's chest**: double jump plus the wind skill; for Toal, double jump plus the fire skill. - **The 2F Path 2 gap** also takes the double jump, not only the wind skill.
**Seeds this could have broken** - Minimal-accessibility seeds with a random start keep the Gold Bracelet as progression, and with the "defeat all bosses" goal they keep their keys and medallions too. Both relied on passages listed above. - The warp item of your own spawn statue is no longer put in the pool (you already have that warp).
## ⚙️ New option
- **`fire_skill_crossing`** (off by default, Toal only). His fire skill is a forward dash that carries him over the 2F Path 2 gap and to the 22F Path 2 chest. Turn it on to let the logic count on that.
## 🛠️ Mod fixes
- **SP chests no longer pay their vanilla SP on top of the seed's item.** - **An altar no longer resets a levelled skill to level 1.** - **Hugo's Eyes of Fact could stay hidden** before the Toal duel after a cut scene. - **Skills and blessing effects are re-derived every tick**, so a skill item can no longer arrive without its skill. - **A watchdog frees scripts stuck waiting on a character that never moves.** - **The log is safe to post.** Your Windows user name, the room's port and private server addresses are left out; the password was never logged. - **Refusals are shown.** When the server turns the connection down (wrong slot, old dll), the menu says why.
## 🔍 For client and tracker authors
- `slot_data` now carries the seed's whole logic as plain data (`logic`: regions, entrances and locations with their rules), so a client can count what is in logic without rebuilding the world.
## ⚠️ What was and was not played
- The **logic** fixes come from a real multiworld run and from walking the rooms in an engine test harness. - The **mod fixes** above are built and reviewed but have **not been played on the retail game** since they were written. The run that found the logic errors was played on another client.
## 🐞 Known issues
- More double-jump spots are likely on floors 18 to 25. A geometry sweep flagged these as suspect and nobody has confirmed them: 18F Path 2 towards Outer Corridor 1, 19F Path 1, 20F Path 1 between the outer corridors and the Drop-Off, 22F Mirror Path, 24F Path 3 and 24F Path 4 towards the 25F save. If you get stuck in one without the Gold Bracelet, please report it. - **Rado's Annex and story order.** Hugo and Yunica can be turned around at the Rado Tower bridge by story flags from higher floors, and Toal by two of his own; his Shion fight can then repeat. Not fixed in this dll. - Used medallions, keys and Moon Crests come back into the inventory after use (cosmetic). - Autosave overwrites slot 8 without asking. `autosave_slot=N` picks another slot, `0` turns it off.
---
**Install:** `ys_origin.apworld` into `custom_worlds/`, `dinput8.dll` next to `yso_win.exe`. `Ys-Origin.yaml` is the option template, or build your own on the [website](https://4rtefakt.github.io/ys-origin-archipelago/).

[Full Readme here](https://github.com/brodieberger/MMZero3Archipelago) [Link to poptracker pack here](https://github.com/ambibii/mmz3-poptracker/releases/latest) ## Features ### Enemy Randomizer (option, WIP) `randomize_enemies` is a (moderately limited) enemy randomizer. Enemies from across the whole game can show up anywhere. This feature is a very big work in progress. Check out the main readme as it has a bunch of known bugs. I'm sure there are plenty more. `enemy_difficulty` determines how enemies spawn in each level. This feature is not fully implemented, so enjoy the placebo: - `minimal`: Tries to match enemy placements by health. If a less health enemy replaces one with more health, place multiple copies at that location. - `chaos`: Places multiple enemies around every spawnpoint regardless of HP or enemy type. Leads to many more enemies per stage. Developer's choice! - `insanity`: Places as many enemies as possible. Tries to prioritize enemies with higher HP. Expect many shield enemies in tight quarters. Good luck! And expect some new additions from the battle network and mettaur mode!
### Traps (option, WIP) `trap_percentage` turns that percentage of your filler items into traps. Select which ones to enable with `enabled_traps`. The three right now are purely visual but I'm planning to do more with them: Earthquake screen, pixelate screen, and slippery floor. ### Enemy disk markers (option) Enemies who drop a disk will have the archipelago icon above them. Recommended for randomized enemies. ### Small stuff + Bug Fixes - Abandoned Research Laboratory no longer has progression items. - Putting the cursor on an item in Cerveau's shop now automatically unlocks its hint. - Fixed bug where Story Progress could be undone by a game over. - Fixed bug where soldier in the Resistance Base's right tower sometimes never gave his check. - Fixed bug where receiving an item while in Ciel's save menu made all of the menu's text disappear. entry.title: Super Crazy Rhythm Castle v0.29.0
entry.content:
# v0.29.0 — Cassette Bundles, Movement and Access Rules
**APWorld 0.29.0 / Client 0.76.0**
October 12, 2026 release.
## Added
- Optional randomized cassette bundles: `individual` (default), `pairs`, or `triples`. Each seed chooses its own groups, preserved across reconnects and Universal Tracker reconstruction. All cassette source and medal checks remain available. - Bundle notifications and recent-item history identify the component songs.
## Fixed and improved
- Corrected Montage animal update timing without forcing a 50 FPS cap. The user accepted the improvement at normal high frame rates. - Made the Regular/Pro Change selector usable before completing Level 1, including the initial save-to-hub transition. - Improved item delivery readiness, deferred retries and native inventory verification so receipts can arrive without restarting. Pair-bundle receipt, deposit, immediate song selection and persistence after restart were verified in gameplay. - Corrected Roots phone-booth presentation so the early portal does not obscure the Gecko and Weed Killer interactions. - Allowed Music Lab reward chests to be opened when their vanilla cartridge reward is already owned. The Bloody Tears chest was verified while carrying Bloody Tears. - Added a Star check before native level-entry side effects to prevent a failed entry from leaving the entrance unavailable until an area reload. This specific recovery case still needs live acceptance. - Removed obsolete movement experiments and the temporary F9 frame-rate test; retained F8 movement capture. Display mode and frame-rate preferences remain native, with no forced fullscreen or frame cap. - Repaired generation capacity for excluded checks by consolidating Music Lab point denominations when needed, preserving all 180 points, 66 Stars and other items.
## Access rules and Universal Tracker
- Lobby Access independently opens Boring Room, Minim Tower and The Vault, retaining each level's own Star gate. - Plunger use requires Lobby Access and Plunger; Lobby Star Eater additionally requires its configured Star threshold. - Corrected direct access to the Plunger, Bees, Frying Pan and Smooch pickups. - Bucket Minion trade requires Roots Access and Hip Glasses without unrelated campaign completion. - Corrected the Demolition Certificate source to use Boring Room rather than Demolition Training. - Removed Central Mainframe from bee-variant access requirements while retaining each ordinary base route, Cell Tower Access and Hypno Pan. - Added the Cell Tower return route for Fish Tears delivery while retaining the native Act 4 award requirement. - Added the Lobby return entrance to Lift Quest and its cassette sources, preserving Roots Access and the level's own Star gate. Combo Bucket conversion still requires its inputs. - Corrected Royal Corridor Star Eater access to area access plus its configured Star threshold. - Required Plant Pipes for Level 15, Level 16's higher ratings and explicitly for Cold Storage. Level 22 retains Plant Pipes as a required logical route. - Loneliness and Party Non Stop retain Hypno Pan. - Improved tracker slot-data validation and cassette-route handling; expanded the prerequisite audit so inherited requirements are visible.
## Compatibility and installation
- Archipelago 0.6.8 generation and Universal Tracker 0.2.32 were tested. - Install `scrc.apworld` in the Archipelago installation used by the generator and Universal Tracker, then restart those programs. - Install the client ZIP following the setup guide before playing a bundled seed. Individual-cassette seeds retain schema 19; bundled seeds use schema 20 and require Client 0.76.0. - Existing seeds retain their item placements, bundle mappings and Star gates. Updated logic does not regenerate an existing seed or guarantee that older placements satisfy newly tightened requirements. - Follow the normal Universal Tracker setup, including its player YAML requirements where applicable; this release does not claim that YAML files are unnecessary. - Packaging retains third-party license notices and excludes game assemblies and local logs. Original project code is MIT licensed.
## Validation
- 190 APWorld tests passed. - 54 official AP 0.6.8 generation cases passed across difficulties, Star goals, cassette modes, exclusions and mixed-game sessions, with independent collection through Victory. - Universal Tracker matched the world rules in 12 worlds and 1,888 inventory states. - The client regression suite contains 42 projects; the release build is verified without installing over the running game. - Both distributable archives passed the release packager's validation.
Automated consistency checks do not establish every native route; gameplay acceptance and remaining limitations are listed separately.
## Known issues and deferred testing
- Cold Storage and Cell Tower Star Eater story prerequisites need further investigation; deferred at the user's request. - School Trip's Plant Pipes requirements and the Gold/On the Way cassette alternatives remain under review. - Higher King Ferdinand ratings depend on late-game Gecko content that is not fully modeled. Those checks remain filler-only and are not guaranteed reachable. - Bunker Keycard, Notepad, Data Stick and Demon Key work remains outside the completed AP-item/check scope; conservative Bunker/Demonic assumptions remain. - Native Hypno Pan crafting alternatives are not comprehensively represented in item logic. - Intermittent song/windowed/Combo Bucket performance and movement outside the accepted Montage case may still occur. - Triple bundles, other delayed-item scenarios, Star-blocked entrance recovery, and the newer Lobby callback readiness paths need further live coverage. - The revised tracker passed offline engine comparisons; a fresh live UI comparison remains useful.
## Development disclosure
This implementation uses substantial AI assistance. See the [AI disclosure](https://github.com/Akamarus/Super-Crazy-Rhythm-Castle-Archipelago/blob/v0.29.0/docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md) for tools, scope, the owner's design and gameplay-testing role, and the limits of human source review. The disclosure should accompany the release announcement and be pinned in the project channel.
## Next
Gather feedback on the updated release and prioritize remaining performance, delivery and native-route reports. Cold Storage/Cell Tower Star Eater testing remains deferred.

entry.content:
## AEMinecraft v0.7.0-rc.3
**Pre-release.** Third test build of v0.7.0. Stay on v0.6.2 if you want a stable game.
This RC only lists what changed since the **[v0.7.0-rc.2 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.2)**. For everything new in v0.7.0, see the **[v0.7.0-rc.1 release notes](https://github.com/KuroLynx/AEMinecraft/releases/tag/v0.7.0-rc.1)**.
### Fixed
- **The game froze on the Nether and Adventure tabs.** With glitch logic on and structure, mob or Knowledge locks, opening those tabs after receiving a few items could freeze the game for good. The tracker now remembers the result of each shared part of a rule instead of working it out again every time it comes up, so the tabs open instantly. Thanks to MissingNoShiny on discord who tracked this one down.
### Changed
- **One Knowledge tile per progressive item.** Progressive Material Handling, Villager Trust, Structure Finder, Keep Inventory and Inventory Slot used to get one tile per copy, which got out of hand with large Keep Inventory or Inventory Slot pools. Each one is now a single tile: - its tooltip counts the copies received so far, e.g. `3/10`; - its frame turns gray from the right, one step per copy, and is fully gray once every copy is in; - the hint line shows where the next copy is. - **Clearer error when the item pool is too big.** When a YAML asks for more items than it has locations, the error now lists how many items each option adds. It only suggests the location options you have turned off.
### Upgrading from rc.2
- **Replace both the apworld and the mod jar.** The tracker tiles changed on both sides, so an rc.2 jar with the rc.3 apworld (or the other way round) leaves the progressive tiles missing from the Knowledge tab. Your YAMLs keep working as they are.

# v0.29.1 — Player movement repair
**October 12, 2026. Client 0.76.1 / APWorld 0.29.0 (unchanged).**
## Fixed
- Fixed the captured player-movement stalls where animation stayed smooth but movement repeatedly slowed or stopped, including after songs and area transitions. Very short input-movement updates now accumulate their elapsed time before being applied, avoiding the observed acceleration resets. - Kept native rendering and frame-rate preferences; this repair does not force fullscreen or a 50 FPS cap.
## Diagnostics and documentation
- Expanded opt-in F8 movement captures with bounded player-update timing records, movement speed values and repair counters. Detailed recording is active only during a capture. - Reorganized the README and current documentation, removed contradictory setup/version guidance, and archived superseded plans and test checkpoints with an index. - Updated the current issue list and recorded the newly completed gameplay acceptance tests.
## Updating
Close the game and replace the client files with **RhythmCastleAP-v0.76.1.zip**, retaining the included licenses. Keep your configuration, current seed and associated save. The APWorld remains **0.29.0**; its logic, IDs, options, item placements, bundle mappings and Star gates are unchanged. An APWorld download is included for convenience, not as a required upgrade from 0.29.0.
## Validation
The movement implementation was accepted in gameplay before its version-only release bump: initial movement, after a Music Lab song, room changes, restart, Hypno Pan NPC movement, stopping, reversing, gentle analogue input, solid-wall collision and pause/resume. Diagnostic samples confirmed the repair active.
Automated coverage includes player timing boundaries, one normal and three faulty recorded timing streams, the timing recorder, movement capture, Montage timing, notification bursts and cassette bundles. All 44 client regression projects passed for publication. The Release build, repository validator, 10 packaging tests and final archive checks passed. NuGet vulnerability metadata could not be fetched; this is not a completed dependency-security audit. Managed tests do not prove every native configuration.

These validate existing behavior rather than introduce new features in this patch.
## Known limits
Intermittent note-affecting performance stalls remain under investigation; the movement repair is not a claim that all frame hitches are fixed. Extended-session and multiplayer movement coverage remains incomplete. Triple cassette bundles and large notification batches have automated coverage but less native acceptance than the tested paths. It is here! After a hiatus, there is now a new version of the Death's Door Archipelago Randomizer and APWorld!
**We're still in beta** Since this is built upon a very stable v0.3.0, there is no concern for crashes or major game breaking bugs, but we'll leave it here for a bit to see if anything does come up.
## To Use **- Randomizer Mod:** Download the attached `plugins.zip` and extract it to `<DDInstallPath>\BepInEx\plugins`. This zip contains the latest versions of all required and recommended mods. **- APWorld:** Download the attached APWorld and drag it into your Archipelago cutom_worlds folder, or simply double click to install it. Make sure to restart your Archipelago launcher after installing.
## New Location Features **- Soul Vault Randomizer:** You can now make the stat upgrades in the Soul Vault into locations that send items intot he multiworld when bought. You can also receive the stat upgrades as progressive items. There are options for placing extra stat boosts in the multiworld. You red it right, our lil crow can now be ultrabuffed! **- Soul vault price modifiers:** **Vanilla** (same as always), **Shuffled** (Same prices, just shuffled between all the upgrades). **Random** (Progressive price increase remains, but all prices will be between a range set in your YAML) **- Seed planting as locations:** Every (X) seeds you plant can now send a check. You can set the amount of seed checks and how many seeds planted sends a check in your YAML up to a maximum of 50.
## New Logic Features **- Plant Pot Tracker:** The Universal Tracker map now shows plant pots in and out of logic. A plant pot will be marked as checked when a seed is planted. No more getting lost/wondering which pots you've already planted! **- Coloured Key Gate Tracker Logic:** When unlocking a gate that requires a coloured key, the Universal Tracker map changes any locations locked behind it as in logic. Before this update, it would only mark locations in logic when you received all keys of the required colour.
## Bug Fixes/Adjustments - Fixed logic for Camp of Crows and Castle Lockstone Doors - Fixed minor filler issues for more reliable seed generation
